tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window background behind everything (carries the ring texture). Text on it: ink, ink-2, ink-3.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, header, footer, popovers. Text on it: ink, ink-2, ink-3, accent-text, info-text, danger-text, warn-text.

tokens.name: surface-inset
tokens.usage: Sunken wells: inputs, segmented-control track, stat chart plots, code chips. Text on it: ink, ink-2, ink-3.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover / pressed fill for rows and secondary buttons on surface.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Modal and wizard sheets, floating menus (above overlay).

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Default 1px hairline: card borders, row dividers, header underline.

tokens.name: line-subtle
tokens.usage: Softest divider: inside dense tables and stat cards.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Border of interactive controls (input, select, unchecked toggle) - meets 3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons; fill of the primary button. Reads on bg, surface, surface-inset, surface-hover, accent-soft.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, subtitles, inactive tabs. On bg, surface, surface-inset.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: captions, units, placeholder-like hints, footer. On bg, surface, surface-inset.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on an ink fill (primary button).

tokens.name: ink-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Leaf green solid: toggle track, slider fill, active tab underline, focus ring, online dot, primary highlights. 3:1 vs surface and bg.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Green used as text or thin icon on surface, bg and accent-soft: links, LIVE badge, active nav label.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background of accent badges, selected rows, connected-state cards.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Border of accent-soft surfaces.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Teal-slate solid: waiting/USB state dot, Z axis, info banner icon. 3:1 vs surface.

tokens.name: info-text
tokens.usage: Teal text on surface, bg and info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info banners and USB-waiting capsule.

tokens.name: info-line
tokens.usage: Border of info-soft surfaces.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Coral-red solid: offline dot, recording dot, X axis, destructive fill. 3:1 vs surface.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (Stop recording).

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Coral text on surface, bg and danger-soft: errors, offline label.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error banners and offline capsule.

tokens.name: danger-line
tokens.usage: Border of danger-soft surfaces.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Amber solid: paused dot, jitter/normal badge, waiting-for-emulators. 3:1 vs surface.

tokens.name: warn-text
tokens.usage: Amber text on surface, bg and warn-soft.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges and the waiting-for-emulators card.

tokens.name: warn-line
tokens.usage: Border of warn-soft surfaces.

tokens.name: axis-x
tokens.usage: X axis series (gyro, accel, bench).

tokens.name: axis-y
tokens.usage: Y axis series.

tokens.name: axis-z
tokens.usage: Z axis series.

tokens.name: viz-leaf
tokens.usage: Reference palette, light green. Illustration, 3D faces, chart series, texture accents - never a text ground.

tokens.name: viz-moss
tokens.usage: Reference palette, moss green. 3D faces and chart series.

tokens.name: viz-teal
tokens.usage: Reference palette, teal. 3D faces and chart series.

tokens.name: viz-slate
tokens.usage: Reference palette, slate blue. 3D faces and chart series.

tokens.name: viz-dusk
tokens.usage: Reference palette, dusk grey-violet. 3D faces, neutral series.

tokens.name: viz-coral
tokens.usage: Reference palette, coral. 3D faces and chart series.

tokens.name: viz-amber
tokens.usage: Reference palette, amber. 3D faces and chart series.

tokens.name: viz-cream
tokens.usage: Reference palette, cream. Highlights inside illustrations only; not a UI surface.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline on the connect screen and wizard step titles.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Brand wordmark in the header, section titles inside cards.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Place your phone still on the desk.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Setting names, button text, tab labels.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Section headers over grouped cards. Set uppercase in CSS (text-transform), letter-spacing 0.08em.

styles.name: mono-xl
styles.usage: Big live numbers: recording timer, latency, frequency.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: URLs, ports, MAC address, axis readouts, versions.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a control, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between rows in a stat grid, control padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Setting row horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section spacing, modal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page gutters on wide windows.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Segmented-control thumbs, kbd, small badges, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, select, chart wells.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Grouped cards, stat cards, banners.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Modal, hero card on the connect screen.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status capsule, url chip, toggle, step pills.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and header on bg.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Modal and floating menus.

tokens.name: shadow-inset
tokens.usage: Engraved wells: inputs, segmented track, chart plots.

tokens.name: shadow-key
tokens.usage: Thumb of the active segment and kbd caps: a hard 1px lip.
